questions.prompt: Which metric is most appropriate for evaluating a binary classification model when classes are imbalanced?
questions.explanation: F1-score balances precision and recall, making it robust to class imbalance.

questions.prompt: In k-fold cross-validation, why do we need to shuffle the data before splitting?

options.text: To ensure each fold has the same distribution

questions.explanation: Shuffling removes any ordering bias that could affect model training and evaluation.

questions.prompt: What is the main advantage of using stratified k-fold over regular k-fold in classification tasks?
questions.explanation: Stratified k-fold preserves the class distribution in each fold, improving evaluation reliability.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT a typical error analysis technique?
questions.explanation: Feature importance explains model decisions, not directly error patterns.

questions.prompt: When evaluating a regression model, which metric would penalize large errors more heavily?
questions.explanation: MSE squares errors, heavily penalizing larger deviations.

questions.prompt: In a time-series forecasting context, why is cross-validation with random splits inappropriate?
questions.explanation: Random splits violate the chronological order essential in time-series data.
